operations.before_publish: revalidate lexical reparse chains and root/parent identities before os.replace
operations.after_publish: revalidate chains, identities, destination regularity, and containment
operations.failure_cleanup: remove only the owned temporary file when it remains a regular non-reparse child of the validated parent

operations.creation: O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY; existing no-replay semantics retained
operations.after_create: verify leaf identity, regularity, and non-reparse status
operations.failure_cleanup: remove only the leaf whose identity matches the file created by this invocation

operations.before_promote: recheck root/parent identity and safe destination
operations.after_promote: recheck identity, regular non-reparse destination, and containment

guarantee_limit: These checks reduce detectable substitution windows but do not claim elimination of the final same-privilege OS race.
